items.name: Classic
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Develop: Quick fixes on the left (Auto edit, Auto tone and white balance, Level, lens fixes) above the presets and history; the Develop panels on the right.

items.name: Beginner
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Classic with words on every toolbar button and only the everyday tools, so nothing is a puzzle. Switch to Classic for icons and the rest.

items.name: Compact
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: One narrow column and smaller controls, for laptop screens.

items.name: Big controls
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Larger text, sliders and targets: easier on touch screens and tired eyes.

items.name: Studio
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: A mixing-desk feel: knobs for light, bars for presence and detail.

items.name: Left-handed
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Classic, mirrored: the Develop panels on the left, presets and history on the right.

items.name: Focus
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: The photo first: no left column, no filmstrip, a short toolbar and one slim column with the everyday panels on top.

items.name: Console
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: A wide mixing console: every main control is a knob, four to a row, so the whole edit fits on one screen.

items.name: Two benches
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Light and geometry on the right, colour on the left: the curve and the grading wheels open side by side with Basic, for wide screens.

items.name: Film lab
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: For scanned negatives and film looks: the negative conversion opens first, then tone, grain and vignette; the crop and white-balance tools sit up front.

items.name: Colour grading
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Colour: big grading wheels on the left; on the right the colour mixer and curve open, and only Basic's colour (white balance, vibrance, saturation), with the light sliders left to Develop.

items.name: Black & white
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: For monochrome: the B&W switch and colour mix on top, then tone, contrast and the curve, with grain and vignette open below and split toning from the grading wheels.

items.name: Retouch
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Retouch: its own tools on the left (Remove object, AI Remove, Heal, Find dust, and the Subject, People, Background and Sky masks), with Detail open and Texture and Clarity as knobs for skin on the right.

items.name: Collage prep
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: For getting a set of photos to match before the collage maker (C): presets and ratings on the left, the filmstrip on (copy one edit and paste it onto the rest in the library, G), quick tone and colour on the right, and Frame, crop and the collage button up front.

items.name: Minimalism
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Only the photo, edge to edge: no menus, toolbar, status bar or filmstrip. Shortcuts all work. The panels slide in over the photo while the pointer is at the window's left or right edge (or with Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+]); the toolbar while it's at the top.

items.name: Dark
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: The default: dark grey panels with a warm accent.

items.name: Light
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Light grey panels with a warm accent.

items.name: High contrast
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Black and white with a yellow accent, for low vision or bright rooms.

items.name: Neutral grey
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: No tinted colours anywhere and a mid-grey viewer, for judging colour.

items.name: Cupertino Light
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Light grey windows, white controls and system blue, in the style of Apple's macOS design guidelines (its published system colours). macOS is a trademark of Apple Inc.; not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.

items.name: Cupertino Dark
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Graphite windows, soft white text and the dark-mode system blue, in the style of Apple's macOS design guidelines. macOS is a trademark of Apple Inc.; not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.

items.name: Swiss print
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Unbleached paper, carbon ink and one hazard red, with square corners: a Swiss industrial print look, after the brutalist guide in the taste-skill design skills (Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT).

items.name: Telemetry
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: A switched-off screen, white phosphor text and one hazard red, with square corners, after the brutalist guide's dark terminal mode in the taste-skill design skills (Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT).

items.name: Stone
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: A low-chroma stone ground with deep green as the one accent and oxblood for warnings: warmth without beige, after the colour guide in the taste-skill design skills (Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT).

items.name: Graphite
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: A deep, slightly cool neutral with one teal accent; panels stand apart by a lighter step, not lines or glow, after the colour guide in the taste-skill design skills (Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT).

items.name: Minimalism
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Near-black around the photo so nothing competes with it; quiet greys and an off-white accent, no colour of its own.

items.name: Airy
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Light and clean: lifted shadows, cool whites.

items.name: B&W Classic
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Balanced black and white with good tonal range.

items.name: B&W Punch
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Deep blacks and bright whites, darkened skies.

items.name: Sepia
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Warm-toned black and white.

items.name: B&W Soft
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Gentle, matte black and white with grain.

items.name: Clean White
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Neutral and crisp, for products and interiors.

items.name: Cloud
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Soft pastels with low contrast.

items.name: Cool Film
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Cool slide-film look with deep blues.

items.name: Dark City
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Urban and cool: crushed shadows, teal and orange.

items.name: Faded Print
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Like an old print: lifted blacks, muted colour, warm cast.

items.name: Golden Hour
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Warm highlights, soft contrast, glowing skin.

items.name: Honey
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Amber midtones and gentle fade.

items.name: Landscape Detail
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: More depth and detail for scenery.

items.name: Moody Forest
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Dark, desaturated greens and teal shadows.

items.name: Night Lights
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Clean night shots: cool shadows, glowing lights, less noise.

items.name: Peach
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Pastel warmth for portraits.

items.name: Soft Portrait
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Flattering skin: softer texture, warm and bright.

items.name: Stormy
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Heavy skies and muted colour.

items.name: Teal & Orange
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: The classic cinematic split: teal shadows, warm skin.

items.name: Vivid Travel
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Punchy colour and clear skies for travel shots.

items.name: Warm Film
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Warm negative-film feel: soft greens, creamy skin, fine grain.

items.name: Toy camera
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: A cheap plastic camera: strong colour and contrast, dark corners and a light leak.

items.name: Miniature
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Tilt-shift: a sharp band and blur above and below, with bright toy colours, so a view from high up looks like a model.

items.name: Infrared
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Surreal colour as on infrared film: green turns pink and red, the sky goes teal.

items.name: Cross-process
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Slide film developed as a negative: blue shadows, yellow highlights, harsh contrast.

items.name: Dreamland
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Soft, shifted colours that drift through the tones.

items.name: Acid
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Psychedelic: every tone a different colour.

items.name: Hologram
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Rainbow foil over the photo, like a hologram sticker.

items.name: Oil painting
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Soft brush strokes that keep the edges, in rich colour.

items.name: Cartoon
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Flat colours with ink lines.

items.name: Poster
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: A few bold tones, like a screen print.

items.name: Pop art
items.author: Ambrotype
items.description: Loud posterised colour.
